road-ambush.name: Ambush on the Bell Road
road-ambush.intro: Cords snap tight across the road. Goblins rise from the fern while a masked lookout signals from the rocks.

snare-rescue.name: The Snare-Keeper's Pack
snare-rescue.intro: The snare line rings like wire. Two briar wolves burst from the mist, thorns bristling through their hides.

hollow-guards.name: The Hollow Court
hollow-guards.intro: The court erupts. A rootbound sentinel tears free of the wall while an acolyte raises a cracked bronze censer.

finale-full.name: The Bell Beneath Briarwatch
finale-full.intro: Sable draws his sabre as the broken bell exhales a figure made of smoke, iron dust, and remembered grief.

finale-weakened.name: The Bell Beneath Briarwatch
finale-weakened.intro: The true chime fractures the ritual. Sable turns on you, and the wraith forms only halfway, its outline leaking silver light.

finale-sable-only.name: The Traitor at the Bell
finale-sable-only.intro: The ward-spirit withdraws from Sable's command. Alone and exposed, the warden answers with steel.
